dinosaur-game.title: Play Dinosaur Game Online - Endless Runner Adventure
dinosaur-game.description: Dinosaur Game, also known as Chrome Dino or T-Rex Runner, is a popular side-scrolling endless runner game. Play offline on Google Chrome and control a pixelated T-Rex to navigate a desert landscape filled with cacti and flying pterodactyls. Survive as long as possible by jumping over or crouching under obstacles. Try Dinosaur Game now and master this engaging arcade adventure!

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Dinosaur Game, also known as Chrome Dino or T-Rex Runner, is a popular side-scrolling endless runner game that can be played offline on Google Chrome. Control a pixelated T-Rex and navigate a desert landscape filled with cacti and flying pterodactyls.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Press the spacebar to jump over cacti.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Press the down arrow to crouch under flying pterodactyls.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Survive as long as possible to achieve a high score.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Enjoy a clean and simple pixelated art style.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Experience endless fun with challenging obstacles.
